data_fields.name: speed_quantum
data_fields.donor_constant: ceil(ground speed / 10), capped at 255 (defect: rounds up, fix to exact)

data_fields.name: ground_speed_per_tile
data_fields.donor_constant: tile type ground speed (value from item data, not read)

best_idea: Keep a small per-tile memory record (seen, blocked, colour, speed) that the minimap draws and the path search reads when the live tile is not known, so one record serves both the map and the route cost.
decision_why: Take the one-record, two-readers shape and the colour-only rebuild flag for the client zone minimap; store exact ground speed (donor rounds up to 10, a defect); keep it client-side since the HUD is client-only; do not copy the 65536 per-floor indexing.
acceptance: The zone minimap shows only tiles the player has seen; a headless test asserts a route query over never-seen tiles returns no path unless the allow-unseen flag is set, and a diagonal step costs three times a straight step at equal ground speed.
